# 自身之预设的两种辖域：沿一个关系，预设次真是闭包上的意义，超真就是公理；路线 (b) 与公理是同一预设，“不论边界怎样划”分别取窄辖域与宽辖域 / The two scopes of the self's presupposition: along a relation the presupposition sub-true is significance over the closure and super-true is the axiom; route (b) and the axiom are one presupposition with “however the boundary is drawn” at narrow and at wide scope

## 主张 Claim

沿一个关系，形成之自身的边界是含它、对此关系封闭的区域（Boundary）：闭包最小，整体最大，每个边界含闭包，关系越小边界越多，一切都在闭包之内时整体是唯一的边界（Boundary.closure、whole、holds、of_larger、only_whole）。关于所划区域的主张，按每个可容许边界成立是超真（SuperTrue），按某个成立是次真（SubTrue），按一个成立就按每个成立是对边界不变（BoundaryInvariant）；有可容许边界时超真就是不变的次真（superTrue_iff），不变就是确定：次真即超真（boundaryInvariant_iff_determinate）。不论怎样划都在自身之内的恰是闭包（superTrue_member_iff），按某种划法一切都在自身之内（subTrue_member）；整体可容许时，“自身之内的都有某性质”超真恰当一切都有，次真恰当闭包之内的都有（superTrue_all_iff、subTrue_all_iff）。预设（SignificantWithin）：从立场 p，所划区域之内一切的延续在每步都有意义。超真时它是可容许边界之并上的意义（superTrue_significantWithin_iff_union），整体可容许时是 p 处的公理（superTrue_significantWithin_iff），与沿哪个关系无关，每个立场都超真恰是公理（unrestricted_iff_superTrue、superTrue_level_free）；沿关系次真时它是闭包上的意义（subTrue_significantWithin_iff），沿较大的关系次真推出沿较小的（subTrue_of_larger），沿全关系是 p 处的公理，沿空关系是中心自身延续的意义（subTrue_total_iff、subTrue_empty_iff）。路线 (b) 以各中心闭包为界的意义，恰是不论怎样划都在自身之内者的意义（bounded_closure_iff），也是使每个预设次真的最小意义（bounded_closure_least）；所以同一预设，“不论怎样划”在窄辖域给出路线 (b)，在宽辖域给出公理（presupposition_scopes）。次序：沿全关系次真推出沿共享条件，沿共享条件推出沿影响与沿受影响，沿受影响推出沿供给，沿任何关系推出沿空关系（Flow.presupposition_order）。预设沿一个含影响的关系在中心次真时，对成员在中心闭包之内的每个部分作公理的比较，不用不变，也不用超真（Flow.Balances.presupposed_comparison，comparison-within-reach 的推论）；沿影响，是所及闭包之内的每个部分（Flow.Balances.presupposed_reach_comparison）。Clearing 中次真依赖关系：以各供给闭包为界的意义使清除者的预设沿供给次真，沿共享条件不次真（Clearing.levels_differ）；清除者自己的预设沿共享条件次真或超真时，从它自己的立场给出它的部分失去栖居者、不保留有意义者；划在供给闭包处，则有一个使部分保留的意义满足它（Clearing.own_presupposition）。不用 Lean 公理。 / Along a relation, a boundary of a formation's self is a region holding it that is closed under the relation (Boundary): the closure is the least and the whole the greatest, every boundary holds the closure, a smaller relation has more boundaries, and where everything lies within the closure the whole is the only boundary (Boundary.closure, whole, holds, of_larger, only_whole). A claim about the drawn region is super-true when it holds of every admissible boundary (SuperTrue), sub-true when it holds of some (SubTrue), and boundary-invariant when, holding of one, it holds of every other (BoundaryInvariant); where some boundary is admissible super-truth is invariant sub-truth (superTrue_iff), and invariance is determinacy: sub-true, the claim is super-true (boundaryInvariant_iff_determinate). What lies within the self however its boundary is drawn is the closure (superTrue_member_iff), and everything lies within it as drawn somewhere (subTrue_member); wherever the whole is admissible, “everything within the self has a property” is super-true exactly when everything has it, and sub-true exactly when everything within the closure has it (superTrue_all_iff, subTrue_all_iff). The presupposition (SignificantWithin): from standpoint p, the continuation of everything within the drawn region has significance at every step. Super-true, it is significance over the union of the admissible boundaries (superTrue_significantWithin_iff_union), the axiom at p wherever the whole is admissible (superTrue_significantWithin_iff), whatever the relation, and super-true at every standpoint it is exactly the axiom (unrestricted_iff_superTrue, superTrue_level_free). Sub-true along a relation, it is significance over the closure (subTrue_significantWithin_iff); sub-truth along a larger relation gives it along a smaller one (subTrue_of_larger), along the total relation it is the axiom at p, and along the empty relation the significance of the center's own continuation (subTrue_total_iff, subTrue_empty_iff). Route (b)'s significance, bounded by each center's closure, is exactly the significance of what lies within the self however its boundary is drawn (bounded_closure_iff), and the least significance that makes every presupposition sub-true (bounded_closure_least); so of one presupposition, “however the boundary is drawn” at narrow scope gives route (b) and at wide scope the axiom (presupposition_scopes). The order: sub-truth along the total relation gives it along sharing a condition, which gives it along affecting and along being affected, being affected giving it along feeding, and any relation along the empty one (Flow.presupposition_order). Sub-true at the center along a relation holding affecting, the presupposition compares every part whose members lie within the center's closure as the axiom does, with neither invariance nor super-truth (Flow.Balances.presupposed_comparison, a corollary of comparison-within-reach); along affecting, every part within the reach closure (Flow.Balances.presupposed_reach_comparison). In Clearing sub-truth depends on the relation: significance bounded by each feeding closure makes the clearer's presupposition sub-true along feeding and not along sharing a condition (Clearing.levels_differ); the clearer's own presupposition, sub-true along sharing a condition or super-true, gives from its own standpoint that its part loses the dweller and does not retain what has significance, while drawn at the feeding closure it is met by a significance under which the part retains (Clearing.own_presupposition). No Lean axiom is used.

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- 覆盖（每个形成都在每个自身的某个可容许边界之内）、预设在每个立场次真、对边界不变，都是假设，不是 Lean 公理；沿一个关系，可容许的边界是含中心、对此关系封闭的每个区域，整体在内，这一可容许性是实质的选择。 / Covering (every formation within some admissible boundary of every self), the presupposition sub-true at every standpoint, and boundary-invariance are hypotheses, not Lean axioms; along a relation the admissible boundaries are every region holding the center that is closed under the relation, the whole included, and that admissibility is a substantive choice.
- 一般定理的前提只有平衡（Flow.Balances）；部分是判定的形成家族。 / The general theorems assume only balance (Flow.Balances); a part is a decided family of formations.
- 有与无一个部分的比较用扣留水平（Flow.WithheldLevels）：扣留这一部分、其余交换不变时的水平，这是表示上的选择；两个流的比较另给第二个流。 / Comparisons with and without a part use withheld levels (Flow.WithheldLevels): the levels with the part withheld and the rest of the exchange unchanged, a choice of the representation; a comparison of two flows is given the second flow.
- 离散的步（从第 0 步计）；自然数的水平、所需与数量。 / Discrete steps, counted from step 0; natural-number levels, needs and amounts.

Ren 在《Truth exist》中写道：“There is a set of universal invariations, that for every universe, becoming happens, the law follows”; “There is no absolute self, and the continuation goes beyond one’s cycle of life, goes beyond one’s death.” 此前写道，自身是 “a cognitive model which can not justify itself without some sort of "belief"”，“we”是 “the universe/ecosystem that realizes its own existence”。AI 提出公理可能由它从 Ren 的话中读出的三个主张推出，只差一步（AI 的话，见来源）；第十六次审查更正：结果是公理的分解，不是化约。作者的读法（AI 论证，待 Ren）：预设读 Ren 所说自身不能没有的 belief，把它用作前提是 AI 的一步；沿一个关系覆盖由构造成立，“we”支持把整体作为一种划法，“There is no absolute self”本身不给出覆盖；“for all beings”最直接地读作对立场不变，即 N_std 的规则，把“universal invariations”推广到意义是 AI 的读法；Ren 的层级读作预设的三种读法：超真、沿影响次真、沿空关系次真。超真、次真之名取自超赋值（Fine 1975）与次赋值（Hyde 1997），依据先前知识；其余名称（Boundary、SignificantWithin、BoundaryInvariant、StandpointInvariant、OneCounts）是 AI 按 Ren 的命名准则所选。 / In “Truth exist” Ren wrote: “There is a set of universal invariations, that for every universe, becoming happens, the law follows”; “There is no absolute self, and the continuation goes beyond one’s cycle of life, goes beyond one’s death.” Earlier Ren wrote that the self is “a cognitive model which can not justify itself without some sort of "belief"”, and that “we” are “the universe/ecosystem that realizes its own existence”. The AI proposed that the axiom may follow from three claims it read from Ren's words, one step short (the AI's words, in the source); the sixteenth review corrected this: the result is a decomposition of the axiom, not a reduction. The author's reading (an AI argument, pending Ren): the presupposition reads the “belief” without which, Ren wrote, the self cannot justify itself, and using it as a premise is the AI's step; along a relation covering holds by construction, Ren's “we” supports the whole as one drawing, and “There is no absolute self” does not by itself give covering; “for all beings” reads most directly as standpoint-invariance, the rule of N_std, and extending “universal invariations” to significance is the AI's reading; Ren's levels read as three readings of the presupposition: super-true, sub-true along affecting, and sub-true along the empty relation. Super-truth and sub-truth are named from supervaluation (Fine 1975) and subvaluation (Hyde 1997), from prior knowledge; the other names (Boundary, SignificantWithin, BoundaryInvariant, StandpointInvariant, OneCounts) are the AI's, chosen by Ren's naming standard.

预设、覆盖与不变本身不推出，预设如每个意义一样是给定的，沿一个关系已带着沿此关系的传递；可容许类没有确定的非成员，所以不是对日常的、模糊的“自身”的超赋值；中心知道其闭包不推出；从意义到理由、动机或实践的一步不推出；读法与名称是 AI 的，待 Ren；G0 已由 Ren 2026-10-11 折叠，不再是公理（P51）。 / The presupposition, covering and invariance themselves are not derived; the presupposition is supplied as every significance is, and along a relation it already carries transmission along that relation; the admissible class has no clear non-members, so it is not a supervaluation of the ordinary, vague “self”; that a center knows its closure is not derived; the step from significance to a reason, to motivation or to practice is not derived; the readings and names are the AI's, pending Ren; G0 was folded by Ren on 11 October 2026 and is no longer an axiom (P51).

- 次真依赖关系，超真不依赖：Clearing 中以各供给闭包为界的意义使清除者的预设沿供给次真、沿共享条件不次真（Clearing.levels_differ）；划在供给闭包处的预设被一个使清除者的部分保留的意义满足（Clearing.own_presupposition）。 / Sub-truth depends on the relation and super-truth does not: in Clearing significance bounded by each feeding closure makes the clearer's presupposition sub-true along feeding and not along sharing a condition (Clearing.levels_differ); drawn at the feeding closure, the presupposition is met by a significance under which the clearer's part retains (Clearing.own_presupposition). ## 复用与下一增量 Reuse and next delta

Ren 的判断：预设是否读出 Ren 的 belief，层级是否读作预设的三种读法；按谱系个体化的自身（Ren 的“the continuation goes beyond one’s cycle of life, goes beyond one’s death”）。 / Ren's judgments whether the presupposition reads Ren's belief and whether the levels read as three readings of the presupposition; a self individuated by lineage (Ren's “the continuation goes beyond one’s cycle of life, goes beyond one’s death”).
